autoheal.title: Auto-heal
autoheal.enableDesc: Restart the container when its Docker healthcheck reports unhealthy. Cooldown between restarts: 30s, 1m, 2m, then 5m. The first heal only happens after the container has been healthy at least once.
autoheal.neverHealthy: Never been healthy (heal will skip until first success)
autoheal.footnote: The container must define a Docker healthcheck. Preference is held in process memory; recreating the container resets it. Every heal is audit-logged and emits an in-app notification.

descriptions.pause: Stops the container while the archive is written, then starts it again. Correct everywhere, at the cost of downtime.
descriptions.snapshot: Freezes the filesystem and reads the frozen copy, so the container keeps serving traffic.
descriptions.live: Reads the running container’s files as they are. Fastest, and the only mode that can produce a torn archive.
